about: One real request and reply per recorder service method (src/recorder/lib/service-protocol.ts), captured from the TypeScript service with a fake host and a fake live recording; paths are invented. The Swift host tests decode these; src/recorder/lib/service.test.ts checks every one against the method's schemas.
